title: Why Is Fire Hot?
hook: Fire is a fast chemical change.
narration: Fire is a fast chemical change.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Is Fire Hot.
Fuel plus oxygen plus heat keep it going.
Let me show you that in 3D.
The change releases extra heat and light.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Never touch fire. Grown-ups handle it.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Fire is a fast chemical change.
The pictures today are a new fire world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why is fire hot.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
